from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor, Inches
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

RATING_COLORS = {"Critical": "C00000", "High": "E26B0A", "Medium": "BF9000", "Low": "548235"}

def new_doc():
    d = Document()
    sec = d.sections[0]
    sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Inches(1)
    sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Inches(1)
    st = d.styles["Normal"]
    st.font.name = "Times New Roman"
    st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Times New Roman")
    st.font.size = Pt(11)
    st.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
    for lvl, size in ((1, 13), (2, 12), (3, 11)):
        h = d.styles["Heading %d" % lvl]
        h.font.name = "Times New Roman"
        h.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Times New Roman")
        h.font.size = Pt(size)
        h.font.bold = True
        h.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x38, 0x64)
        h.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(12 if lvl == 1 else 8)
        h.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
    # footer page number
    p = sec.footer.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    r = p.add_run("Privileged & Confidential — Attorney Work Product — Page ")
    r.font.size = Pt(8)
    _field(p, "PAGE")
    return d

def _field(p, code):
    r = p.add_run()
    r.font.size = Pt(8)
    f1 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f1.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "begin")
    it = OxmlElement("w:instrText"); it.set(qn("xml:space"), "preserve"); it.text = code
    f2 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f2.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "end")
    r._r.append(f1); r._r.append(it); r._r.append(f2)

def _runs(p, text, bold=False, italic=False, size=None):
    # supports **bold** segments
    parts = text.split("**")
    for i, seg in enumerate(parts):
        if not seg:
            continue
        r = p.add_run(seg)
        r.bold = bold or (i % 2 == 1)
        r.italic = italic
        if size:
            r.font.size = Pt(size)
    return p

def para(d, text, bold=False, italic=False, align=None, size=None, indent=None):
    p = d.add_paragraph()
    _runs(p, text, bold, italic, size)
    if align == "center":
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    elif align == "justify":
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
    if indent:
        p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(indent)
    return p

def bullet(d, text, level=0):
    p = d.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    _runs(p, text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
    return p

def numbered(d, text):
    p = d.add_paragraph(style="List Number")
    _runs(p, text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
    return p

def quote(d, text):
    p = d.add_paragraph()
    p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(0.5)
    p.paragraph_format.right_indent = Inches(0.4)
    _runs(p, text, italic=False, size=10)
    shade_par(p, "F2F2F2")
    return p

def shade_par(p, color):
    pPr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd"); shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear"); shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto"); shd.set(qn("w:fill"), color)
    pPr.append(shd)

def shade_cell(cell, color):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd"); shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear"); shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto"); shd.set(qn("w:fill"), color)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def table(d, header, rows, widths=None, size=9, rating_col=None):
    t = d.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(header))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]
        c.text = ""
        _runs(c.paragraphs[0], h, bold=True, size=size)
        shade_cell(c, "D9E2F3")
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, val in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text = ""
            lines = str(val).split("\n")
            for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
                pp = cells[i].paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else cells[i].add_paragraph()
                pp.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
                _runs(pp, ln, size=size)
            if rating_col is not None and i == rating_col and val in RATING_COLORS:
                shade_cell(cells[i], RATING_COLORS[val])
                for r in cells[i].paragraphs[0].runs:
                    r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF); r.bold = True
    # repeat header
    trPr = t.rows[0]._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    th = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader"); th.set(qn("w:val"), "true"); trPr.append(th)
    if widths:
        for row in t.rows:
            for i, w in enumerate(widths):
                row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    d.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def issue(d, num, title, sections, rating, problem, why, rec, language=None, fallback=None):
    d.add_heading("Issue %s. %s" % (num, title), level=3)
    t = d.add_table(rows=1, cols=2); t.style = "Table Grid"
    c0, c1 = t.rows[0].cells
    c0.text = ""; c1.text = ""
    _runs(c0.paragraphs[0], "DPA provision(s): " + sections, size=9.5)
    _runs(c1.paragraphs[0], "Risk rating: " + rating, bold=True, size=9.5)
    shade_cell(c1, RATING_COLORS[rating])
    for r in c1.paragraphs[0].runs:
        r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
    c0.width = Inches(4.6); c1.width = Inches(1.9)
    para(d, "")._p.getparent().remove(d.paragraphs[-1]._p)
    p = d.add_paragraph(); _runs(p, "**The problem.** " + problem)
    p = d.add_paragraph(); _runs(p, "**Why it matters / support in the record.** " + why)
    p = d.add_paragraph(); _runs(p, "**Recommendation.** ")
    if isinstance(rec, list):
        for r_ in rec:
            bullet(d, r_)
    else:
        p.add_run(rec)
    if language:
        p = d.add_paragraph(); _runs(p, "**Proposed language:**")
        for l in (language if isinstance(language, list) else [language]):
            quote(d, l)
    if fallback:
        p = d.add_paragraph(); _runs(p, "**Fallback position.** " + fallback)
